question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

There are rows of chairs on either side of the ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Aisle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Aisle**" refers to a passage between rows of seats or shelves. (सीटों या अलमारियों की पंक्तियों के बीच का मार्ग)

 
 
• **For example**: *She walked down the aisle, adorned in a beautiful white gown.*
 
 
 
• The sentence describes rows of chairs, so an aisle would be necessary to allow people to walk between them.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence**: *There are rows of chairs on either side of the aisle__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Ail**" means to cause pain or trouble, and is not relevant to the sentence. (दर्द या परेशानी पैदा करना)
 
• "**Isle**" refers to an island, and is not relevant to the sentence. (एक प्रायद्वीप)
 
• "**I'll**" is a contraction of "I will", and is not relevant to the sentence.
